items.title: Actual Chebyshev-Lobatto momentum integrals are nonnegative

source.anchor: Appendix B.1, Proposition B.1 (B2), momentum positivity clause, HTML1686-1713; consumer Lemma4.6
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang; only actual momentum integral positivity.

items.statement: For every integer J>=2, every real h>0 and every j in Fin J, with t_i=(h/2)(1-cos(i*pi/(J-1))) and ell_j=Lagrange.basis univ t j, the actual momentum weight omega_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s) ds is nonnegative.
assumptions: J is an integer >=2 and h is a positive real duration. Fin J uses zero-based indices; source indices are1,...,J.
t_j=(h/2)(1-cos(j*pi/(J-1))), ell_j is the actual Lagrange cardinal polynomial on all these nodes. All j in Fin J are quantified, including both endpoints.

Weights are actual interval integrals against ordinary real Lebesgue measure. Polynomials are continuous and hence integrable on the finite intervals; these facts are proved, never supplied as premises.
